legal.notes: All 7 citations are properly formatted with working reference links. NORC study is real and publicly accessible. NHTSA data sources are government records. ESC mandate date (2012 MY, per FMVSS 126) is correct. IIHS ESC effectiveness numbers match published research. Ref 6 (ride-hailing ~6%) lacks a direct URL — referenced through secondary source. rigor.notes: Novel contribution: cross-referencing enforcement decline (NORC/Fell 2025) with FARS toxicology by vehicle class (490,736 drivers) to show stable impairment rates alongside declining fatalities. Limitations acknowledged in disclaimer (fragmentary enforcement data, observational causation, Colorado generalizability). Counterargument stated at full strength. Methodology transparent for FARS sample. Minor weakness: 'engineering compensating for policing' is more inference than proven causal link — acknowledged via 'observational' caveat.
